teacher_isolation_note: Teacher calibration and per-row labels were produced by the original build_sc5_canonical_corpus_v2.py which had access to all 10 Object tasks. Student row split is strict 8/1/1, but teacher labels may carry indirect information about val/held_out tasks through calibration thresholds. This is a STUDENT-ONLY isolation canary. Full teacher-isolated LOTO requires re-running privileged teacher calibration on train tasks only, which needs raw step_records.jsonl files.
